messages:
maria: Quick one — when someone clicks the download link for a tenant's audit export, what do we currently surface in console telemetry?
kevin: We emit export_initiated (tenant_id, export_id, initiator_id when available). For presigned flows today we only log presigned_generated, not the actual GET.
alex: Legal is asking for 'who downloaded what when' for some enterprise contracts. Problem: presigned URLs mean the server never sees the actual GET. Options: short-lived presigned + require user session to request the presign (so generation == attribution), or proxy downloads through a server that logs each GET.
nora: Proxying every GET sounds heavy (bandwidth + infra). Could we make proxying opt-in per-tenant, or only enable proxy for customers that require it? sampling also possible.
maria: Legal specifically wants full fidelity for Dedicated/Private customers. For Hosted customers they said sampling is acceptable but needs to be documented.
kevin: Implementation idea: introduce export.metadata.attribution_mode = one of ["generate_only","proxy_all","proxy_on_flag"]. Default generate_only. Add telemetry event export_download_confirmed when we see a proxy GET with actor_id.
alex: API change debate: do we let callers pass actor_id into presign endpoint as a query param? that's easy but spoofable. We should attach actor attribution server-side — only from an authenticated user session.
nora: Agreed — no query param for actor_id. UI should clearly show who will be attributed before you click generate. For rollout UX, show a small banner if the tenant is enrolled in audit-proxy.
maria: Console needs a downloads table: columns = time, attributed_to (link to user), method (presigned/proxy), file_hash, and an export-proof link. Also want a downloadable bundle that includes a signed proof-of-access artifact.
kevin: Minimal API sketch (RFC):
```
POST /v1/tenants/:id/exports
body: { type: "ndjson", include_proof: true, attribution_mode: "proxy_on_flag" }
response: { export_id, presign_url || download_proxy_url }
```
If attribution_mode != "generate_only" and tenant has proxy flag, return download_proxy_url. Telemetry: emit export_download_attempt, export_download_success, export_download_proxy_latency with tags (tenant, attribution_mode).
alex: For the proxy_on_flag flow presign -> /download/:export_id?token=... route should validate session and either redirect or stream while logging. We should log range headers to capture partial-downloads.
nora: Quota/billing question: should proxy GETs count against tenant outbound bandwidth quotas? For Hosted probably yes; for Dedicated maybe not (depends on contract). Need billing + console cost panel update.
maria: We'll need a privacy guard: logs may contain actor email. Store only actor_uid in telemetry and provide a mapping service to resolve to email for authorized viewers. Also TTL on the mapping.
kevin: Another idea to satisfy legal without proxying everyone: include a signed proof object in the export bundle at generation time — a JWT signed by our KMS that contains { export_id, generator_actor_id, timestamp, file_hash }. That way, even if someone later downloads via presigned link, the generator proof is verifiable. But that doesn't prove a later download by a different actor.
alex: Right — proof_of_generation vs proof_of_access. If legal needs proof_of_access, we must log the GET. The JWT proof is nice for generation-level audits.
nora: Rollout plan proposal: target Dedicated/Private customers first with proxy_all default for those accounts. For Hosted, expose attribute flag and start canary with 5 tenants. Feature-flag behind audit-proxy.
maria: Action items:
- kevin: draft API shape + telemetry metrics/trace spans (export_initiated, export_presign_generated, export_download_attempt, export_download_success, export_download_proxy_latency).
- alex: design proxy implementation and signed-proof-of-access format.
- nora: console mockups for attribution UX + billing widget changes.
- maria: coordinate with legal + sales on comms + contract language.
Anyone object / other ideas?
kevin: No objections, will open RFC + PR and attach sample telemetry fields.
export-bot: Created ticket INFR-3123: "export: add attribution_mode, download-proxy, telemetry + proofs" (<https://tracker.local/INFR-3123>) :white_check_mark:
maria: Also note retention: legal wants 7 years for some customers. We'll need retention tiering + export of logs to the customer's S3 for long-term storage.
kevin: For retention, we'll add export_download_events to tenant export bundles and optional streaming to a customer-owned bucket.
alex: Small security note: if we proxy, ensure we stream with chunked transfer and keep memory usage bounded. Also add a rate limiter per-tenant on proxy endpoint.
nora: Quota interaction again — downloads should decrement export_download_quota; if a download fails mid-stream we should not double-bill.
maria: Cool. Let's sync tomorrow 10am to go over mocks + API diffs.
kevin: I'll post RFC by EOD.
